map.📖 查看「阅读时长估算器使用指南」: 📖 View the "Reading Time Estimator User Guide"
map.估算阅读时长有助于排期与撰写摘要。本工具分别统计中文字符与英文单词，按常见阅读速: Estimating reading time helps with scheduling and writing summaries. This tool counts Chinese characters and English words separately and converts them into minutes by common reading speed, giving an approximate time needed.
map.阅读时长(分钟) = 中文字符数 ÷ 中文阅读速度 + 英文单词数 ÷ 英文阅读: Reading time (minutes) = Chinese character count ÷ Chinese reading speed + English word count ÷ English reading speed; common speeds are 300 to 500 Chinese chars/min and 200 to 250 English words/min (default 400 chars/min and 200 words/min may be taken); aloud time is about 1.5 to 2 times silent reading (Chinese aloud about 200 chars/min); the result is rounded up to the minute.
map.在纯前端工具站里，阅读时长估算是一个很实用的小功能，帮助用户判断一篇长文需要投入: In a purely front-end tool site, reading time estimation is a very practical little feature, helping users judge how much time a long article will take.
map.中文阅读速度因人而异，普通成人约 250–400 字/分钟；英文母语者约 200: Chinese reading speed varies from person to person; an ordinary adult reads about 250–400 chars/min, and an English native about 200–250 words/min. Adjustable parameters adapt to different readers.
map.本工具把 CJK 统一段字符（中日韩）计入中文字数，英文数字计入词数，互不干扰。: This tool counts unified CJK segment characters (Chinese, Japanese, Korean) as Chinese characters and English digits as words, without interfering with each other.
map.估算仅为参考：技术文、带代码或图表的内容实际更慢，娱乐性内容可能更快。: The estimate is for reference only: technical articles, content with code or charts is actually slower, and entertainment content may be faster.
map.公众号/博客发文前，估算一篇中英混排文章的大致阅读时长，帮助在标题或文末标注“约: Before publishing a WeChat official account / blog post, estimate the approximate reading time of a Chinese-English mixed article, helping label "about X minutes to read" in the title or at the end.
map.课程或培训材料排版时，按中文与英文的不同: When laying out course or training materials, compute separately by the different
map.分别计算，给出更贴近真实的总耗时。: of Chinese and English to give a total time closer to reality.
map.内容平台做推荐/排序时，用阅读时长作为权重因子，避免长文被误判为低完成度。: When a content platform does recommendation / ranking, use reading time as a weight factor to avoid long articles being misjudged as low completion.
map.一篇含 1200 个汉字、80 个英文单词的文章，取中文 300 字/分钟、英文: An article with 1200 Chinese characters and 80 English words, taking Chinese 300 chars/min and English 200 words/min: Chinese takes 1200÷300=4.0 min, English 80÷200=0.4 min, total 4.4 min, rounded up to about 4–5 min (the tool shows integer minutes by Math.round).
map.中文和英文为什么分开算？: Why are Chinese and English calculated separately?
map.两者阅读速度不同：中文按字符数、英文按单词数计速更准。工具用正则分别统计中文字符: Their reading speeds differ: counting Chinese by character count and English by word count is more accurate. The tool uses regex to count Chinese characters and English words separately, then divides by their respective speeds and adds them.
map.标点、空格、数字怎么算？: How are punctuation, spaces and digits counted?
map.中文统计只看 CJK 汉字（\\u4e00–\\u9fff），英文单词按 [A-: Chinese statistics only look at CJK ideographs (\u4e00–\u9fff); English words are split by [A-Za-z0-9]+; punctuation and pure spaces are not counted separately, and the result is an integer minute not less than 1.
